title: ARTS WAY MANUFACTURING CO INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Art's-Way Manufacturing Co., Inc. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held April 21, 2026. Stockholders elected five directors, ratified Eide Bailly LLP as independent auditor, approved an amendment to the 2020 Equity Incentive Plan to add 500,000 shares, and approved executive compensation on an advisory basis.
key_points: Five directors elected: Marc H. McConnell, Thomas E. Buffamante, David A. White, Matthew Westendorf, Randall C. Ramsey
Eide Bailly LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year ending November 30, 2026
Equity Incentive Plan amended to increase reserved shares by 500,000
Advisory say-on-pay vote approved with 3,444,356 votes for
All matters passed with votes for exceeding withheld/abstain by significant margins
